definitions.shares: Fractions 0–1; denominator is all product-color observations, including missing-price rows.
definitions.missing_prices: Unknown, not full-price. With missing prices, shares are confirmed discounted counts / all observations (lower bounds). Bands exclude unknowns.
definitions.averages: Equal weight per discounted product-color observation; null if none are discounted.
definitions.rounding: Exact rational arithmetic for classification and aggregation; output rounded to six decimal places.
definitions.promotions: promo_text, stored discount_pct, and stored is_discounted are not used.

historical_context.comparability: Price concepts and product-color unit supported; date, assortment, coverage, ranking, and offer eligibility differ. Not a matched-panel trend.
